blurb: Polynesian Fire is an authentic Polynesian dinner show company serving Myrtle Beach, Daytona Beach, and Orlando. We are a Samoan family coming to you from the village of Nu’uuli on the island of Tutuila, American Samoa. The performers of Polynesian Fire will captivate you during live Polynesian music, ethnic dances and Samoan fire knife performances.
